questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop and let other traffic pass before proceeding. You can continue when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers the direction they must drive when entering a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that wet pavement may be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage and loss of control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or with mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointed downward, it means the rider is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit if conditions are not ideal, such as bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic and pedestrians. Let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Watch for people in the crosswalk, slow down, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction and maintenance signs are orange. This sign warns you that construction work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Stop only if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and other vehicles. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway at a ramp. You must either exit or change lanes to continue through the interchange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal is used when riding in groups to tell other riders to follow you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the road ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns of an upcoming railroad crossing. Watch for trains and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign tells drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be prepared to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is one-way and you cannot enter from your current direction.
